title: Which environment makes distance per cycle (not speed) pay for the Marangoni rods? Supply that a daughter can reach only by leaving its birth site, against the sink-disc environment, with the ladder world
summary: c50's four-loop campaign (20261027T0240-c50-marangoni-spread-paired4) found that growing sink discs and short-lived food patches select the faster Marangoni kind (trait mean above the identical-event twin on 4 of 4 seeds) but not the challenge's capability: a faster rod also divides sooner (speed vs cycle Spearman -0.28 to -0.65), so distance per cycle is unchanged and the M-gate share follows the seed (1 of 4 seeds above the twin). c45's screen showed that the growth throttle gm does not move distance per cycle either. The missing piece is a supply that pays only after the rod has travelled, so speed cannot be converted into a shorter cycle at the birth site.
experiment: One loop. World: 20261027T0000-c50-marangoni-spread-loop1/world.py (ladder, all founders mar 40, mutation 2.5e-3 per frame, sink discs one per 50 t). Add a birth-site depletion: at each persistent split (detected trait-blind from the field: a body whose label count rises), lower the chemostat target to phi_in inside a disc of radius R_d (try 2 and 4 rod lengths) centred on the parent's last centroid, for one median cycle (~200 t). The daughters must leave the depleted disc to grow; nothing reads a body's kind or speed. Arms on 2 fresh seeds: E (ladder) and the identical-event twin, plus a no-depletion arm (the loop-1 world) on the same seeds. Readouts: spread_stats.py and fate_kind.py from 20261027T0000-c50-marangoni-spread-loop1 (trait mean, kind shares, M-gate passers with the rear-tip test, D gradient). Pass: in E the D gradient is positive and the M-gate share is higher than in the twin and in the no-depletion arm on both seeds. If it passes, take it to 4-6 paired seeds, or to 192^2 (about 30 min per run) where 40+ bodies make the per-seed trait mean readable.
